theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) = affinePullbackForm (lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P)) 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) → Y ω = X η) → Y.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ k) * X.mass
